description: Genie Ontology Modeled Knowledge SDK. Build-0 (archived): build the reusable SDK and dogfood it on samples.tpch into examples/tpch/. Build-1: CI, library fixes, wheel, reconciled and published skills, run kit and guided notebook, exhaustive MV-first tuning of the TPC-H agent until accuracy flattens, an independent report simulation, then the customer path on a second domain.
